versions.content: If several applications are using the same RAM block it is not the job o f the NvM module to ensure the data integrity of the RAM block. In this case, the applications have to synchronize their accesses to the RAM block and have to guarantee that no unsuitable accesses to the RAM block take place during NVRAM operations (detail s see below). Especially if several applications are sharing a NVRAM block by using (different) temporary RAM blocks, synchronization between applications becomes more complex and this is not handled by the NvM module, too. In case of using callbacks as n otification method, it could happen that e.g. an application gets a notification although the request has not been initiated by this application. All applications have to adhere to the following rules.
